items.title_orig: Today's Estate Sale Haul: $5 each. R.E.M. Monster, Murmur, and Pearl Jam Self are 1st Pressings and in NM Condition. Cure Pornography is early pressing. Been a while since l had found anything!
Villarreal - The Telegram and WhatsApp Wars - Part 9
items.article_text:
We begin with his questions about my fake pics and how I look so young. How? “Pearl Jam” cream that costs $600 a month. This represented my final attempt to bait him to an ask. He knew that Charlotte had money, but he insisted upon a relationship first which I refuse to even fake with him. And of course my “pearl jam” deserves a Pearl Jam lyric. 
 Villarreal did the calculations. $600 a month means $7200 a year. Hmmmm. If only Charlotte could stop silly things like that and send Villarreal foodstuffs and an Apple Card for his connection. He even wanted to know how much it costed when I first began using it. Could an ask be near? I introduce Irving as my accountant and talk about Jews For Jesus, but he doesn’t care. So what do you want to talk about, Villarreal?
